order: This pass closes out every finding from the prior review round. It starts with a rewrite of the test-authoring seat's mirror-substitution conflict text so it matches the exception now declared for that seat, an exception the cross-family exception recorded elsewhere already closes, and the lint check then gets verified to exit clean once the fix lands. The documentation seat's dropped rule, that the inert verification tier never applies to documentation, gets restored at its original plan lines and stays unchanged from before. The legacy-validation rule-count table gets fixed for the base and heavy executors, since the base carries ten rules while heavy carries twelve, including two rules unique to heavy alone. The environment-variable deviation gets described as caught on review rather than self-disclosed, because the report's own deviations line already says none. The cross-vendor engine fault tally gets stated as exactly ten of fourteen engine-reaching attempts, with a full per-attempt list replacing the earlier wrong figure.
claims: All five major findings and six minor findings from the prior round were fixed, and every outstanding nit was cleared too, spread across ten files in total. The cross-vendor engine fault tally was recomputed as exactly 10 of 14 engine-reaching attempts, arriving with an explicit counting rule and a full per-attempt list. That figure replaces the earlier wrong tally of roughly six of fifteen, so the record now reflects what actually happened. The rule-count table now reads ten base rules and twelve heavy rules, checked against the source files row by row.
